ordering_resolution: The owner explicitly removed calendar waiting as a development gate. T0705 therefore uses one protected workflow_dispatch that invokes the exact SCHEDULE planner path and is labelled SCHEDULE_REHEARSAL rather than pretending to be a platform schedule event. Only after every data-plane, recovery, zero-collateral, cleanup and single-Timeline oracle passes may the existing committed 04:30 Australia/Sydney schedule be enabled.
rollback: Before protected PASS, keep MOOMOOAU_PRODUCTION_ENABLED absent or false and remove the one-shot rehearsal authority variable. On any failure, retain immutable recovered Raw, do not advance the encrypted Gmail checkpoint, disable production scheduling and freeze the exact failed head at attempt 1 with rerun zero. After PASS, a later operational fault disables the schedule variable and preserves the last verified code, Raw and encrypted state.
